overview: BoardWalk Villas are Disney Vacation Club rooms sharing the BoardWalk Inn's building, with the BoardWalk's shops and restaurants right outside.
suits: Families and couples who want villa space and evening entertainment within walking distance of two parks.
rooms: As a Disney Vacation Club resort, rooms range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen and washer and dryer. You don't need to be a member to stay; you can book with cash like a regular hotel.
pools: Guests use Luna Park Pool, with its wooden-coaster waterslide, plus quieter pools.
dining: Guests use the BoardWalk restaurants, including Flying Fish and Trattoria al Forno.
pros: Walk to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
cons: Buses to Magic Kingdom and Animal Kingdom
tips: Ask for a quieter room if you're an early sleeper.
Use the Friendship boats as a relaxing ride to Hollywood Studios.
bestFor: Families and couples who want villa space by the BoardWalk.
